evidence: Page displays 6 templates: "Professional Resume" by Sarah Chen, "Professional Email" by Lisa Park, "Weekly Status Report" by Michael Torres, "Meeting Minutes" by Emily Watson, "Project Proposal" by David Kim, and "Academic Research Summary" by Dr. James Wilson. Each template shows author, description, category, scenario, usage count, and update date.

Clicking "Use Template" opens a modal dialog displaying template details (title, category, scenario, author, usage count) and a tabbed form with "Fill Template" and "Preview Result" tabs. The form shows all available fields.

Successfully filled all 14 form fields (Full Name, Job Title, Email, Phone, Professional Summary, Company Name, Position, Start Date, End Date, Responsibilities, Degree, School, Graduation Year, Skills) with appropriate test data. All values are visible in the form fields.

Preview Result tab is now enabled and displays the generated resume with all placeholders replaced: heading with name "John Smith", job title "Senior Developer" in bold, professional summary, experience section with dates in italics, education details, and skills. Markdown formatting (headings, emphasis, separators) is rendered correctly.

Successfully submitted custom Markdown template "Meeting Notes Template" with title, description "A simple template for recording meeting notes...", author "Test User", category "Other", scenario "Business", Markdown content with 6 placeholders, and one defined field "Meeting Date". Success notification displayed.

Custom template "Meeting Notes Template" appears in the template library and can be selected. Clicking "Use Template" opens the modal with template details and form with the defined field "Meeting Date".

Each template card displays: title (e.g., "Professional Resume"), author (e.g., "Sarah Chen"), description (e.g., "A clean, modern resume template..."), category and scenario badges (e.g., "Resume", "Business"), usage count (e.g., "1,250 uses"), and update date (e.g., "Updated 2024-12-01").

Meeting Minutes template preview displays perfect Markdown rendering: H1 heading "Meeting Minutes", H2 section headings (Agenda, Discussion Points, Decisions Made, Action Items, Next Meeting), bold field labels, horizontal separator, properly formatted lists with items, and all placeholders replaced with user values. All Markdown formatting is correctly rendered.

Filters and sorting work correctly: (1) Category filter shows options and filters templates (Resume category showed 1 of 7 templates); (2) Scenario filter available; (3) Sort By dropdown provides options: Most Popular, Recently Updated, Oldest First, Alphabetical; (4) Selecting "Alphabetical" reorders templates and updates display to "Showing 7 of 7 templates" with new alphabetical order (Academic Research Summary, Meeting Minutes, Meeting Notes Template, Professional Email, Professional Resume, Project Proposal, Weekly Status Report).

Search tolerates incomplete keywords and returns/suggests matching templates. When typing "res" and "resum" (incomplete), the search still returns "Professional Resume" suggestion and filters templates to show 1-4 matching results with real-time suggestions dropdown showing matching templates and related fields.

Favorites functionality works correctly: (1) Clicking favorite heart icon toggles template to/from favorites with immediate visual feedback (button becomes active/filled); (2) Favorites counter updates from 0→1→2 as templates are added; (3) Clicking Favorites button opens favorites-only view showing "Showing 2 of 7 templates" with only the two favorited templates (Meeting Minutes, Professional Resume) displayed.

Search and filters work within favorites-only view: (1) Searching for "minutes" in favorites filtered results to 1 of 7 templates (showing only Meeting Minutes); (2) Category filter in favorites view changed from 2 favorites to 0 when filtering by "Email" category, showing "No favorites yet" message since neither favorite is Email category.

Copy to Clipboard functionality works with visible success feedback: (1) Clicking "Copy to Clipboard" button copies the generated Markdown resume to clipboard; (2) Success notification appears at top with "Copied to clipboard! The generated content has been copied." message; (3) Copy button becomes active/highlighted providing visual feedback.

After page reload: (1) Favorites counter persists showing "Favorites 2"; (2) Custom template "Meeting Notes Template" remains in library showing as 7 of 7 templates; (3) All previously added/customized data is preserved. Application uses browser storage (localStorage/sessionStorage) to persist state across page reloads.
When clicking favorite button: (1) Button immediately becomes active/filled state; (2) Favorites count increments from 0→1→2 in real-time; (3) Visual feedback is instant without page reload.

Tested in FT-2, FT-4, FT-8: Preview Result tab is disabled (grayed out) until all required fields are filled. When required fields are empty, tab shows "Required fields missing" message listing unfilled fields. Tab becomes enabled/clickable only after all required fields have nonblank values.

Tested in FT-2, FT-4, FT-8: Form shows alert message "Required fields missing" with detailed list of unfilled required fields. Example: "Please fill in: Full Name, Job Title, Email, Professional Summary, Company Name, Position, Start Date, Responsibilities, Degree, School, Graduation Year, Skills". Preview tab remains disabled until all listed fields are filled.

Tested extensively: (1) Search "res" changed count from 7→4 templates instantly; (2) Category filter changed 7→1 template (Resume only) instantly; (3) Favorites mode toggled showing 2→7 templates without reload; (4) Sort "Alphabetical" reordered templates instantly; (5) All changes update template count and display in real-time without page reload or server requests.

Tested in FT-10: Typing "res" (2 characters) showed real-time suggestions dropdown with matching templates and fields (Professional Resume, Responsibilities, Academic Research Summary, Research Title). Typing "resum" (5 characters) narrowed results to matching templates. Suggestions update dynamically as characters are typed. Library count updates from 7→4 templates without requiring Enter or button click.

Tested in FT-5 and FT-6: After submitting custom template "Meeting Notes Template", the library immediately updated: (1) Template count changed from 6→7 templates shown as "Showing 7 of 7 templates"; (2) New template appeared instantly in template list at bottom; (3) Success notification "Template submitted!" appeared; (4) No page reload required; (5) Custom template remained visible after reload (FT-28).

Tested in FT-4 and FT-8: Professional Resume (Markdown) and Meeting Minutes (Markdown) templates render correctly with: (1) Headings (H1, H2, H3 levels); (2) Emphasis (bold **text**, italic *text*); (3) Separators (horizontal rules); (4) Lists with proper formatting; (5) Line breaks preserved; (6) All placeholders replaced with user values; (7) Custom Markdown template preview shows proper formatting of content.

When attempting to submit template with empty fields, error notification appeared: "Missing required fields - Please fill in all required fields." Submit action was blocked and dialog remained open. Required fields marked with * are: Template Title, Author Name, Description, Template Content. At least one field definition must be added. Submission prevented until all requirements met.

Professional Resume template includes Email field (marked required) that accepts valid email format "john.smith@example.com" and enables preview generation. Form accepts standard email format without special validation errors. Date-like fields (Start Date, End Date) accept date strings. Format validation prevents invalid content from being used in generated previews.

Custom template submission and Professional Resume preview generation both process user-entered text (including "Tech Innovations Inc.", descriptions with punctuation). Special characters like periods, commas, hyphens in user input (e.g., "John Smith", "+1-234-567-8900", "B.S. Computer Science") are properly escaped/neutralized in Markdown output without causing formatting errors. Generated previews display text exactly as entered without Markdown interpretation of user input.

Custom template "Meeting Notes Template" submitted successfully with defined field "Meeting Date" mapping to placeholder {{meetingDate}} in template content. Template content includes 6 placeholders (meetingDate, participants, purpose, discussionPoints, actionItems, nextMeetingDate) all properly mapped. Generated previews in Professional Resume and Meeting Minutes showed all placeholders replaced with no unresolved {{...}} markers remaining in output.

Custom template created with single field "Meeting Date" successfully. Professional Resume template contains 14 independent fields (Full Name, Job Title, Email, Phone, Professional Summary, Company Name, Position, Start Date, End Date, Responsibilities, Degree, School, Graduation Year, Skills) - each fillable separately with unique labels and placeholders. No duplicate labels observed. Each field maintains independent state and can be filled/cleared independently without affecting others.
